status: frozen before any sealed outcome value was read by the model developer
context_of_use: U1 initial-state-only prediction of a new study's control-group mean projected fluorescein wound-area fraction after central epithelial debridement, from species group and initial wound diameter
U2 causal next-observation forecasting of each animal/eye (own prefix, and cohort prefixes at the same origin hour) for control and treated groups
not_claimed: other injury families or species without training data

observation.noise: Gaussian in sqrt(area) with study-level SD, log-normal prior marginalized on 11 levels
observation.noise_center_rule: median study SD over all training studies unless >=3 individual-data studies

population.levels: series within study within species/injury context; diagonal within- and between-study covariances
population.fit: two-stage: grid posterior moments per series, then penalized REML (Nelder-Mead, deterministic restarts)

development_changes_before_freeze: per-study noise and censored zeros after development LOSO showed one coarse study inflated a pooled noise SD
noise prior widened (log-SD 1.0, z +/-2.5) and centred on the median over all studies
between-study lag penalty mode 3 h -> 5 h, reflecting reported rabbit latent phases of roughly 4-16 h
within-study covariance made diagonal; Student-t (df 4) cohort priors; fallback priors with doubled SD
cohort (concurrent cage-mate) assimilation added as the practical online use

training: all development studies: consumed abdel-naby2017, suarez-barrio2019 (all treated: steroid+NSAID care), chung2021, plus dio-mouse-plos-one-2020 and ketamine-rat-sci-rep-2022; controls fit the population, all series supply noise estimates and the analog library

sealed_test.custodian: separate sub-agent extracted sealed records, reported only structure/hashes

excluded_by_custodian.norepinephrine-commun-biol-2025: no identifiable observation times / hour-0 values

sealed_test.licence_note: LSC record is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 derived data and stays private; only metrics are published

criteria.per_series_U2: RMSE<=5 pp AND max<=10 pp AND RMSE at least 0.5 pp below persistence
criteria.calibration: pooled 90% interval coverage of cohort_assimilation within [0.80,0.97] and 80% within [0.70,0.90]
criteria.primary_comparison: pooled RMSE of cohort_assimilation lower than last_two_radius_trend over targets where both exist
criteria.all_points: every sealed series/target is scored; none removed; thresholds unchanged after unsealing
